services.desc: We’re often asked: Is martial arts appropriate for older adults? At White Dragon, the answer is absolutely yes! Our expert team of instructors is specially trained to meet the needs of the older student. And, since White Dragon teaches several complete systems of martial arts, we can design a training program that’s tailored to your specific needs and goals, regardless of your age or level of physical ability. So, whether it’s learning Kung-Fu for self-defense, or Tai-Chi for low impact workouts that strengthen the immune system, White Dragon has the training program that’s right for you!
